name: Austral-Nave
description: Grass-plains and basalt shields alternate across the habitable belt, stitched together by a nearby asteroid belt. Farther poleward, past an ancient meteor crater, the silence feels older than the soil.

The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Leviathan fauna breach the sea-mist at dusk, singing on frequencies felt in the teeth.
the derelict space station in orbit still shows toolmarks half-finished. Whatever called everyone away did not give them time to say goodbye.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on medicinal compounds, iron, biomass and uranium are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
